Fetch
is a privately-owned specialty and emergency veterinary practice delivering trusted care to pets and their families in Brandon, FL, just outside Tampa Bay. We are here to serve as an extension of your pet’s primary care, providing elevated services to address their complex medical needs through our board-certified veterinary specialists. Should you need to turn to us for your pet’s care, you can be assured that our specialty vets and staff will treat your pet with the same love and attention you give them every day.

Emergency Pet Services in Brandon, FL
Should your pet require urgent veterinary attention, our Brandon, FL team is accessible around the clock, 365 days a year—including holidays—to assist you. We recognize the unforeseen nature of pet emergencies and are committed to providing dependable support for both you and your pet. You deserve to have confidence in your care options and access to a proficient veterinary team with just a simple phone call. Whenever you need expert advice or immediate care for your pet, contact Fetch. For further details on our emergency services, click below!

Critical Care
Our facilities are equipped to provide critical care to pets in need of life-saving treatment. With our highly-trained critical care team, there’s very little we can’t handle (and make better) for our patients.
Learn More

Ophthalmology
Where can you find a vet ophthalmologist? Right here at Fetch. We guide pet owners to understand and manage all kinds of eye conditions and help their companions see, and feel, better.

Internal Medicine
We can give pets a better quantity and quality of life with the aid of our internal medicine specialists and services. If your pet is living with chronic disease, Fetch has the knowledge and resources you need to support them.

Diagnostic Imaging
Our team uses digital X-rays, ultrasound, and CT scans to perform detailed health evaluations and provide accurate results for our patients. If your pet needs more advanced care, our innovative technology delivers.

Medical Oncology
At Fetch, we have incredible veterinary oncologists on our team to help patients conquer cancer. In addition to diagnosing various types of cancer, we offer a range of treatment options that can be tailored to your pet.

Radiation Oncology
Our oncology team often employs radiation therapy as a treatment for dogs and cats. Radiation therapy is intended to target and destroy any residual cancer cells following surgery, which helps to prolong and enhance the quality of your pet's life.
